# netactuate_vpc_gateway_standby (Resource)

Manages a VPC Gateway Standby.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_gateway_standby" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID that should have a redundant standby gateway.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_gateway_standby.example 12345
```
